facts.text: Reed, I'm made of rock and I still can't get a decent sandwich. Fix that next.
facts.why: No quote page opened has Ben asking for a sandwich. TV Tropes shows his real Brooklyn Bridge line ('You take a good look, pal!') and nothing about lunch. It reads as an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: Reed, I'm made of rock and I still want a sandwich. Cure first, then lunch.

vibe.verdict: A tidy lab canteen with decent powers-themed dishes, but light on the film's best-known beats.
missing: Johnny shouting 'Flame on' and flying off a building (Doom's missile)
Sue's force field on the Brooklyn Bridge
Ben and his fiancee Debbie ending it (the bridge)
Doom frozen in place by thermal shock (the finale)
ideas: Swap the 'Stretchy cheese pull bread' note for 'Reed can reach the top shelf without standing.'
Swap the 'Cosmic storm sundae' note for 'Served just before it hits.'
Swap 'Iced coffee with ice cream' house note for 'Hot and cold, ask Doom.'
